subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw add an automatic soft-steer lifecycle that aborts an in-progress model turn, preserves its valid partial state, injects the newest user message, and resumes the same logical task?
rationale: Current OpenClaw intentionally exposes boundary steering and interrupt-and-restart as separate modes; combining them changes shared agent-run, tool, transcript, and fallback semantics that implementation code cannot safely choose without product intent.

options.title: Define automatic soft steer
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify the lifecycle invariants and backend capability contract before implementation.

options.title: Keep separate queue modes
options.body: Declare boundary `steer` plus abort-and-restart `interrupt` as the supported product model and close the broader automatic-resume direction.

recommendation.title: Define automatic soft steer
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify the lifecycle invariants and backend capability contract before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent central active-run steering implementation makes this the strongest available owner for framing the lifecycle decision with adjacent contributors.
